items.name: meshy-mcp-server
items.description: MCP with 24 tools: text or image to 3D, remesh, retexture, rig, animate, convert, UV unwrap, 3D-print checks, balance.
items.verdictNote: SKIP for now. Revisit one month of Pro only when a 3D character needs rigging.
items.why: Needs a Meshy API key on Pro or above: $20/month (1,000 credits), Premium $40, Ultra $100 (meshy.ai, Oct 2026) Free plan outputs are CC BY 4.0 (attribution required) and have no API 24 stars, 9 commits
items.license: MIT (server); Meshy plan terms for outputs
items.source: research 2026-10: content, motion, 3D and game tools

items.name: blender-mcp
items.description: Blender add-on plus MCP server: the agent builds and edits scenes in a live Blender, can run Python inside Blender, pulls Poly Haven (CC0) models, textures and HDRIs, searches Sketchfab and Poly Pizza, and can call Hyper3D Rodin or Hunyuan3D.
items.verdictNote: ADOPT on an 8 GB GPU (Blender is already in the stack), with telemetry off and safe mode on.
items.why: It runs arbitrary Python in Blender over an UNAUTHENTICATED local socket: keep it on localhost and turn on BLENDER_MCP_SAFE_MODE=1 Telemetry is ON by default and may be used to train AI models: set DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true Sketchfab and Poly Pizza models have mixed licences (CC-BY needs credit); Poly Haven is CC0 Save the.blend file before letting the agent run code
items.source: research 2026-10: content, motion, 3D and game tools

gpu.vramNeeded: Blender viewport works on 8 GB; heavy Cycles renders slower
gpu.on8GB: Use now for mesh clean-up and GLB export

items.name: godot-ai
items.description: 46 tools / 120+ operations for a live Godot 4.7+ editor: scenes, scripts, signals, UI, particles; authenticated loopback connection.
items.verdictNote: CONDITIONAL: install only for a Godot project, telemetry off.
items.why: Telemetry ON by default (install ID, events, platform): set GODOT_AI_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true It writes and hot-reloads GDScript, so it executes code in your project Several copy forks exist: use hi-godot only
items.source: research 2026-10: content, motion, 3D and game tools

items.name: Unreal tools: UnrealClaude, Unreal_mcp, VibeUE, unreal-engine-skills, UnrealGenAISupport
items.description: Five Unreal Engine 5 agent tools. UnrealClaude (907 stars, UE 5.7, 20+ tools, script execution denied by default). Unreal_mcp by ChiR24 (856 stars, UE 5.0-5.8, capability token ON by default: the safest of the group). VibeUE (589 stars, UE 5.8+, rides Epic's own Unreal MCP plugin; terrain, Niagara, profiling). unreal-engine-skills (335 stars, 27 skills, 1 commit; the post said 31). UnrealGenAISupport (634 stars, LLM NPCs; its MCP is no longer developed; warns that API keys in shipped builds are a security risk).
items.verdictNote: SKIP for indie web-game web games; if a PC 3D title ever happens, start with Epic's official MCP + VibeUE or ChiR24's Unreal_mcp.
items.why: Unreal 5 is too heavy for web games and for an 8 GB GPU Several can run arbitrary Python or C++ in the editor

items.name: mcp-unity (CoderGamester)
items.description: MCP bridge for the Unity 6 editor: 32 tools for scenes, GameObjects, assets, materials, tests, console errors and play mode; Node 18+. Last commit 2026-10-11.
items.verdictNote: skip unless a Unity project starts
items.why: Best-maintained of the Unity bridges reviewed, but irrelevant for web-engine games. Its WebSocket (port 8090) has no stated authentication; never enable 'Allow Remote Connections'.
